details.title: Harmonic minor scales
details.lead: Harmonic minor: natural minor with the 7th raised, so the scale leans hard into the tonic. The step and a half between the 6th and 7th is its sound. Each key goes up and down two octaves from its lowest tonic, then over the whole horn: up to the highest note of the scale at or below double high B♭, down to the lowest, and back to the tonic.
facts: All 12, from B♭ up by half steps
